title: Reverse Linked List
summary: Reverse the direction of every link in a singly linked list.

contractDetails.constraints: 0–5,000 nodes. Node values are integers in [−5,000, 5,000]. The input is acyclic and need not be sorted.

statement: Reverse the direction of every link in a singly linked list. Return its new head, or a null head for an empty list. The judge constructs nodes from the input array and serializes the result by following next links.

examples.explanation: The former tail becomes the head.
An empty list has no links to reverse.
Equal values still occupy distinct nodes.

constraints: 0–5,000 nodes. Node values are integers in [−5,000, 5,000]. The input is acyclic and need not be sorted.
hints: Conceptual: Each original edge points the opposite way in the result.
Directional: Keep a pointer to the portion you have already reversed.
Implementation: Save the current node's original successor before redirecting its next link. Advance to the saved node and return the last node processed.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space with iterative pointer updates.
